# Clario

> Clario is an AI content workspace for creators and teams to summarize, remix, chat, and manage brand voice.

## What Clario does
- Summarizer: turn articles, text, URLs, and YouTube videos into structured summaries with multiple modes.
- Remix Studio: repurpose one piece of content into platform-native formats (e.g. posts, threads, scripts, outlines).
- AI Chat: creator-focused chat with conversation history.
- Brand Voice: save and apply a consistent voice across outputs.
- Dashboard: track usage, summaries, remixes, chats, comments, repurposes, and recent activity.
- Calendar, history, templates, queue, and toolkit utilities for content workflows.

## Plans
- Free: limited monthly requests (see pricing).
- Pro: higher limits and priority processing (see pricing).

## Technical notes
- Built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Supabase, and Stripe.
- Authenticated app areas require sign-in; public marketing pages are indexable.
